name: @aperio/shared
description: Shared, platform-agnostic frontend TypeScript for Aperio — domain types and pure logic reused by the desktop frontend (Vite) and the mobile app (Expo/Metro). Starts with the task domain (types, grouping, status/label helpers); calendar hooks, settings handlers, and other reusable bits move in here over time.
//: Resolved via a path alias on each side (no bundler-specific main/exports), so imports like '@aperio/shared' work in both Vite and Metro — same mechanism as @aperio/locales. This package MAY take pure-JS runtime dependencies (it already imports rrule and linkify-it), but every one of them must be declared in BOTH the repo-root package.json and mobile/package.json: Metro does not hoist from here, and a dependency missing on the mobile side fails the EAS production bundle while the dev server keeps working. Never a dependency with native code — mobile pays for that twice.
